metaTitle: Admissions & Procedure | Santosh Group of Institutions
metaDescription: Admission criteria, step-by-step procedures, documents checklist, and academic examination schedules for SGI schools and colleges.

intro.title: Admissions for Academic Year 2026-27
intro.lead: Join an institution with over three decades of educational excellence. Follow the step-by-step procedure below to secure your seat.

eligibility.criteria: Open to all eligible students as per state age norms. Transfer certificate and previous academic records required for Grade 1 and above.
Candidates who have passed SSLC / ICSE / CBSE or equivalent 10th standard examinations. Out-of-state candidates require a migration certificate.

eligibility.institution: Santosh Degree College (BBM, BCA, B.Com, BA)
eligibility.criteria: Successful completion of 2-year Pre-University Course of Karnataka State or any equivalent 10+2 examination recognized by Bangalore University.
Pass in 10+2 / PUC with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for SC/ST and Category-1 candidates).

steps.title: Obtain Application
steps.desc: Collect the official application form from the college admissions office or submit an online inquiry.

steps.title: Submit Form & Documents
steps.desc: Submit the completed application form along with attested copies of marks cards and certificates.

steps.title: Selection Announcement
steps.desc: Merit list of selected candidates is announced on the campus notice board and via direct communication.

steps.title: Principal Interview & Verification
steps.desc: Selected candidates meet the Principal along with parents/guardians with all original certificates for final enrollment.

documents: Original & Attested Copies of SSLC / 10th Standard Marks Card
Original & Attested Copies of PUC / 12th Standard Marks Card (for Degree & D.Ed)
Original Transfer Certificate (TC) issued by the institution last attended
Original Migration Certificate (for candidates originating outside Karnataka State)
Conduct / Character Certificate from the head of the previous institution
Caste and Income Certificate (if claiming quota concessions)
